extraction.name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)
extraction.description: MTEB is a benchmark for text embeddings that spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. It aims to provide a comprehensive evaluation framework for text embedding models across tasks such as bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff; Nouamane Tazi; Loïc Magne; Nils Reimers
extraction.citeAs: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, and Nils Reimers. 2023. MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. arXiv:2210.07316.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB was assembled by aggregating datasets from prior benchmarks and repositories, and by creating some custom datasets for MTEB from publicly available sources and APIs. The benchmark incorporates SemEval datasets and BEIR, uses Hugging Face dataset names where data has been uploaded, and includes custom-made clustering datasets built using the public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv as well as available data from Reddit and StackExchange posts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Web API; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Source data include SemEval datasets (STS11 - STS22), BEIR datasets, datasets available on the Hugging Face Hub, public APIs from arXiv and bioRxiv/medRxiv, and available data from Reddit and StackExchange posts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: MTEB average scores, which are computed over all datasets, are biased towards tasks with many datasets, notably retrieval, classification and clustering.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Long document datasets are still missing and the longest datasets in MTEB have a few hundred words; Task imbalance with summarization consisting of only a single dataset; retrieval and clustering are English-only; MTEB does not contain any code datasets; the scale of experiments and model pre-training makes controlling for data contamination challenging, so overlap of MTEB datasets with model training datasets is ignored in MTEB scores
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: This leads to the “blind” application of these models to new use cases in industry or requires incremental work to reevaluate them on different tasks; We hope our work makes selecting the right embedding model easier and simplifies future embedding research; our studies on scaling behavior, model efficiency and multilinguality revealed various intricacies of models that should ease the decision-making process for future research or industry applications of text embeddings
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks; evaluation of any embedding model; finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks; selecting the right embedding model for future research or industry applications of text embeddings
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We welcome dataset, task or metric contributions from the community via pull requests to continue the development of MTEB; Through versioning at a dataset and software level, we aim to make it easy to reproduce results in MTEB; We welcome task, dataset or metric contributions to the MTEB codebase as well as additions to the leaderboard via our automatic submission format
